findings.passage: This resolution is about protecting election integrity and making sure Ohio voters feel completely confident about the voting process here in our state, Enshrining voter ID into the Ohio Constitution ensures that this protection is not taken away by future General Assemblies.
findings.note: Quoted statement in a House release on introducing joint resolutions to put voter ID into the state constitution (he is a primary sponsor of HJR 9). Passage joined from the fetch tool's word-for-word segments; a comma sits between the two sentences as returned.

findings.passage: By codifying these requirements in Ohio's Constitution, the joint resolution will ensure the integrity and long-term security of our elections.
findings.note: From a newsletter item issued by his office. It says SJR 10 would require in-person voters to show valid, unexpired government-issued photo ID, notes current law requires voter ID since December 2022 and offers free state ID cards to Ohioans 17 and older, and says the question will be on the November ballot.
